subject: Empower.ai — post-demo load test coordination and k6 artifacts
messages:
From: James O'Neill <james.oneill@empower.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Park <sophia.park@empower.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T13:05:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: performance targets and load test window

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team found the streaming behavior and the latency metrics encouraging. To keep momentum, here's what we'd like to validate in a customer-led load run: 

- Targets: p95 latency <= 200ms for standard generate endpoint; p99 <= 450ms under sustained load
- Throughput/concurrency: target sustained throughput 120–150 requests/sec, peak concurrent connections ~350
- Streaming: we need to validate SSE chunking behavior for responses over ~1k tokens and confirm that connection keep-alive works for long-lived streams
- Auth: we'll use a test API key with restricted scope; please provide the test key and IP ranges that you'll allow for the k6/Locust runners
- Window: we prefer a 2-hour test window on Sept 17 between 22:00–00:00 UTC (team in PST/EU will be available)

Can you confirm the above and send a short checklist of what's needed on our side (accounts, any special headers, recommended traffic profile)? Also please share the initial k6 script you recommend so our SREs can review.

Best,
James O'Neill
Head of Platform Engineering, Empower.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: James O'Neill <james.oneill@empower.ai>, Sophia Park <sophia.park@empower.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: performance targets and load test window

James — great to hear. Recap and next steps below. Thanks for enumerating targets; we've captured them exactly. 

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Latency targets: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 450ms (validate under sustained 120–150 req/s)
- Peak concurrency: ~350 connections (we'll simulate long-lived streaming sessions where ~20% of requests use streaming)
- Streaming behavior: validate SSE chunk delivery and keep-alive over at least 90s per connection
- Test window: 2026-09-17 22:00–00:00 UTC (2 hours)

What Redwood will provide before the window:
- Temporary test API key with restricted scope (expires after test)
- IP allowlist for our test endpoints (we'll ask you to add these to your runners' network config)
- Reference k6 script (attached: k6_empower_smoke.js) and a recommended traffic matrix (attached: load_matrix_empower.xlsx)
- Runpoint: Connor (cc'd) will be the run leader and will own ramp schedule and abort conditions; Rishi will provision the test creds and coordinate infra changes

Action items for Empower.ai:
1) Confirm you can accept IPs from the ranges in ip_allowlist_empower.csv (we'll provide actual CIDRs when Rishi posts them)
2) Create a dedicated test user(s) or confirm we'll use the test API key we provision (which will be scoped to the test account)
3) Quick review of the attached k6 script — call out anything you want simulated differently (auth header, custom cookies, SSE parsing)

Proposed immediate timeline:
- Today EOD: Rishi will post the CIDRs and create the test API key (temp)
- 9/16: Engineering review of k6 script and traffic matrix; small adjustments if needed
- 9/17 22:00 UTC: Customer-led load run (2 hours)

If this looks good I will start the internal runbook and schedule a 30m dry-run with Connor and your SREs on 9/16.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: k6_empower_smoke.js (script), load_matrix_empower.xlsx (traffic matrix)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, James O'Neill <james.oneill@empower.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T15:02:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: Empower.ai load run — infra tasks and allowlist

Team — looping you in to prepare internal infra and run leadership. Summary of what I need from infra and run ops (Connor/Rishi):

1) Create a temporary test API key scoped to the Empower test account that will be valid for 48 hours after the test. Provide the key as a one-time secret (we'll place in run_credentials_empower.txt stub).
2) Publish IP allowlist CIDRs to the shared drive and send the csv to Empower (filename ip_allowlist_empower.csv). Start with these candidate ranges: 34.120.0.0/16, 35.194.0.0/16, 104.196.0.0/14 (we'll confirm exacts before 17th)
3) Confirm streaming connection limits per instance and whether we need an autoscale bump for the test window. If so, request reserved capacity for 9/17 21:30–00:30 UTC.
4) Provide k6-friendly endpoint hints: preferred keep-alive header, recommended max http2 concurrent streams, and any token refresh cadence for longer sessions.

Tester notes to include in runbook (Connor):
- Ramp plan: 0 -> 60rps over 10m -> 120rps over next 20m -> hold at 120–150rps for 60m -> graceful ramp down 20m
- Abort conditions: sustained p95 > 600ms for 10m, error rate > 3% sustained 5m, 5xx spike > 2%
- Streaming checks: validate chunk ordering and delta arrival times for messages >1k tokens

Attachments referenced: k6_empower_smoke.js (reference script), load_matrix_empower.xlsx (traffic profile) — both attached to the thread. I'll send the CIDRs as soon as Rishi confirms them and we'll publish run credentials to the shared drive link below.

Thanks — Stephanie

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, James O'Neill <james.oneill@empower.ai>, Sophia Park <sophia.park@empower.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:10:00Z
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Empower.ai load run — infra tasks and allowlist

On 2026-09-15 15:02, Stephanie Nguyen wrote:
> Team — looping you in to prepare internal infra and run leadership. Summary of what I need from infra and run ops (Connor/Rishi):

Got it — quick status update and what I pushed: 
- Test API key: provisioned (scoped to /v1/generate and /v1/stream endpoints), key stored in run_credentials_empower.txt on the shared drive, expires 2026-09-19T16:10:00Z. NOTE: I'll rotate it after the run.
- IP allowlist: published candidate ranges to Drive and attached csv (ip_allowlist_empower.csv). Please confirm with Empower that their runners can source from these CIDRs.
- Capacity: Verified current fleet headroom; added a temporary 2-node burst pool allocated to the Empower test window (21:30–00:30 UTC) to cover peak streaming concurrency. Autoscale policy relaxed for the window.
- Streaming knobs: recommended keep-alive header: Connection: keep-alive; recommended http2 MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS set to 100 per connection for this run. No token refresh required for the 2h window with current key.

Run artifacts and links:
- Drive runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EmpowerTestRunbook
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/EP-4721

Attachments: ip_allowlist_empower.csv, run_credentials_empower.txt

I'll be on the 9/16 dry-run to validate the handshake and the 9/17 run. If Empower asks to change CIDRs, we'll update quickly — keep me looped.

— Rishi
Lead Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
